message: Hi, my little one Owen is 6 and wants to try jiu jitsu. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! Yes, we do! We have a Kids Martial Arts class for ages 4-7 that covers both Gi and No-Gi Jiu-Jitsu.
It's a great foundational class for Owen's age. Would you like to book a free trial class for him?
Yes, I’d love to book a free trial class for Owen! What time slots do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?
Great, thanks Tester! Can I get your email address? That way we can send you the confirmation and class details.
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! And what's Owen's full name?
Owen's full name is Owen Slate.
Thanks! Last thing - what's Owen's date of birth? This helps us make sure he's in the right class group.

Perfect! Owen is 6, so he's a great fit for our Kids 4-7 class. Here are some available times for his free trial:

Today Monday at 5:00 PM
Tuesday at 5:00 PM
Saturday at 8:30 AM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with today, Monday at 5:00 PM. Thank you!
Awesome! Owen is all set for today at 5:00 PM. You'll get a confirmation email shortly with all the details. Just come a few minutes early and we'll get you checked in. See you soon!
